name: Gaia Glow Subtraction
summary: Subtracts a physical model of bright-star glow, with fluxes predicted from Gaia DR3, ported from the GaiaGlowSubtraction Siril script.
description: AfterNight port of GaiaGlowSubtraction for Siril by Adrian Knagg-Baugh, an independent reimplementation of PixInsight's PhotometricGlowSubtraction from its public documentation. On a linear, plate-solved, stacked image it models the extended glow of each bright star as its flux, predicted from Gaia DR3 (XP spectra or temperature) through a zero point calibrated on the image's own stars, times an extended PSF measured on the image, fits the background jointly, protects star cores, and subtracts the result. Stars brighter than G = 4 take their flux from Hipparcos. Gaia catalogue pieces are downloaded from the Siril catalogue mirror and cached. The numerical core is the upstream script's, unchanged. AfterNight port by Ezequiel Ruiz.
author: Adrian Knagg-Baugh (original) / Ezequiel Ruiz (port)
attribution: AfterNight port of GaiaGlowSubtraction for Siril by Adrian Knagg-Baugh. Gaia DR3 data: ESA/Gaia/DPAC. AfterNight port by Ezequiel Ruiz.
